g.text: Does the object modality help *because* its vocabulary covers the catalogue?

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #6b6a63

g.text: LATTICE on the shipped default_fixed variant, seeds [0, 1, 2], paired by seed. Tiers are F17's: exact = the item's label is a node of the object graph, far = no node within cosine 0.6.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #6b6a63

g.text: Metric is per-test-item hit@20 (of all (user, test item) pairs in the stratum, the share where the item made that user's top-20); the offline ranking reproduces every run's logged Recall@20 to <3e-5.
